Definition
[Convergence in $W^{k,p}(U)$ and $W^{k,p}_{\text{loc}}(U)$] ↗ def:sobolev-norm 1. ch5:5.2-def-4\group Sobolev Spaces

(i) Let $\{ u_m\} _{m=1}^\infty $, $u \in W^{k,p}(U)$. We say $u_m$ converges to $u$ in $W^{k,p}(U)$, written \[ u_m \to u \quad \text{in } W^{k,p}(U), \] provided \[ \lim _{m \to \infty } \| u_m - u\| _{W^{k,p}(U)} = 0. \]

(ii) We write \[ u_m \to u \quad \text{in } W^{k,p}_{\text{loc}}(U), \] to mean \[ u_m \to u \quad \text{in } W^{k,p}(V) \] for each $V \CC U$.
